title: The ideas behind the reforms: the Washington Consensus
goal: Read what the market reforms proposed and who applied them, using relative clauses.
grammar: relative clauses with que, quien and donde

items: I can say what neoliberal ideas are and what their defenders argue.
I can say who coined the term “Washington Consensus”, when, and what it listed.
I can name the presidents who applied the reforms in Argentina, Mexico and Peru.
I can add information about a person, an idea or a place with *que*, *quien* and *donde*.
